import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static PrintWriter out;
    static double EPS = 1e-9;
    static int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static long LINF = (long) 1e18;
    static int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static double PI = Math.acos(-1);

    // Use a different I/O: DataInputStream for speed
    static int go(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        long k = 1;
        int cnt = 1;
        while (k * 10 + 1 < n) {
            k = k * 10 + 1;
            cnt++;
        }
        return (int) Math.min(go(n % k) + n / k * cnt,
                go((k * 10 + 1 - n) % k) + (cnt + 1) + (k * 10 + 1 - n) / k * cnt);
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(System.in);
        long n = 0;
        boolean negative = false;
        int c = dis.read();
        while (c <= ' ') c = dis.read();
        if (c == '-') { negative = true; c = dis.read(); }
        do { n = n * 10 + (c - '0'); } while ((c = dis.read()) >= '0');
        if (negative) n = -n;
        out.println(go(n));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        solve();
        out.close();
    }
